rv.q: Ernestine’s journey is an emotional epic, and Fry makes each step truthful.

Haidle and Thebus make the universal extremely personal here, and there is no way to explain that except to tell you to come to experience the most perfect trip on life's roller coaster that the theatre can take you on.
It’s a performance, indeed an entire production, that should definitely not be missed.
Haidle produced this fantastic storyline of witnessing the life of Ernestine through a series of birthdays.
Although it's possible to imagine a maudlin or mundane staging of this play, the Northlight production sings.
There could be no better way to enter his world than to catch “Birthday Candles,” now receiving an exceptional production by Northlight Theatre.
This is one of those DO NOT MISS! plays.
As the play concludes, the audience comes away with having experienced a very thoughtful and philosophical theatrical performance.

cn.t: Critics praise this poignant, life-affirming drama for its emotionally rich portrayal of an ordinary woman's life through birthday milestones. Kate Fry's performance and Haidle's beautiful, poetic writing earn acclaim in this tear-jerking production.
